BimanualContactHistoryObservation.description:
Two hand summaries share one complete acknowledged action interval.

Same-side self contact and cross-side robot contact partition the global
self-contact impulses. Overlapping substep counts must never be summed.

semantics.const: positive solved normal impulses; per-hand self_contact includes same-side robot pairs only; cross_side_contact includes any left-right robot pair, including arms; global self_contact counts every robot pair once; pad coactivity does not imply opposition, a common object or grasp success
semantics.title: Semantics

BimanualContactHistoryObservation.title: BimanualContactHistoryObservation

semantics.const: positive solved normal impulses; coactivity does not imply opposition or a common object; each unique pair counted once per involved region
semantics.title: Semantics
